rv.q: That the same might be said of the play's effect upon us is, more than anything, what makes "Faith Healer" a major work of art.
The play’s paradoxical identity as a tragic celebration of the artist’s craft comes into focus in a moment that is uplifting and shattering at the same time.
This Faith Healer , however, makes attempting to divine what really happened the most engrossing mystery of the year.

Theatergoers in search of a gripping drama about what constitutes genuine healing and abiding faith in an increasingly faithless world won’t find it here, but those who want to see three actors showing their considerable mettle will have come to the right place.

cn.t: Critics praise this powerful revival of Friel's monologue play, with Fiennes delivering a mesmerizing, narcissistic performance that commands attention. While some question the dramatic structure, most find Kent's production masterful and the storytelling compelling.

vs.sum: The Booth Theatre offers good sightlines with a well-raked mezzanine and clear views from most seats, though legroom can be tight. The theater's elegant, European-inspired design adds to its charm, while sound quality is consistently praised. Facilities are average, with typical restroom and concession offerings.

acc.note: 6 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Not completely wheelchair accessible. Infrared devices available.
